messages:
Ava: Heads-up — eval dashboard is showing a step change for the Llama-2 q8 run on the summarization suite. Not a perf spike but a consistent metric drop ~3.7% on ROUGE-L across all seeds. Anyone else seeing this?

Liam: yep saw the alert at 11:02, opening thread. CI run failed thresholds for stable/regression gating.

ci-bot: job #4821 failed: eval-suite/summarization/llama-2-q8 — regression 3.7% (threshold 2.0%). Full logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4821

Maya: quick check — nothing changed in eval harness code in last 7 days. Metric calc code at eval/metrics/rouge.py unchanged. My local run reproduces ~3.6%.

Zara: I ran a bisect pair over model artifacts and infra: rolling back to runtime v1.18 -> metrics align back to baseline. Patch that introduced tokenizer normalization (runtime#9f3a2b) landed yesterday.

Devon: interesting. Tokenizer normalization? That was supposed to fix whitespace for tokenizers across models. Could change tokenization of punctuation which affects ROUGE reference alignment.

Ava: can we get a minimal repro? Put the exact diff/commit id that moves numbers.

Zara: commit 9f3a2b74 changed tokenizer to strip zero-width joiners and normalize curly quotes in the decode path. Bisect trace: 9f3a2b74 -> delta +3.7%, revert to 8e1c4a9c -> delta ~0.0%.

Liam: repro on my laptop. Gist of decode mismatch:
```
# pre-change decode: "Hello — world."
# post-change decode: "Hello - world."
```
Small changes in punctuation spacing shift n-gram overlap. ROUGE is brittle here.

Maya: summary: not an eval harness bug, it's a change in inference decode postprocessing. Options: (1) revert tokenizer normalization, (2) change eval to use model-tokenizer paired detokenization (apply same normalize to references), or (3) update gating thresholds for this class of models.

Devon: preference is (2) long-term. We should make evals apply the same detokenization pipeline we run in production for that model family. Short-term we need a release decision.

Ava: SLA: Dedicated customers expecting stable evals — we need a hotfix. Propose revert commit on runtime branch and cut a patch release, while we implement (2) in the eval harness. Agreed?

Liam: agree. Revert + patch is quickest. I'll open PR to revert 9f3a2b74 and add a test in eval-ci that token-level detok parity holds between runtime decode and eval preproc.

Maya: I'll own the eval-harness change: add a normalization adapter so references are normalized via the runtime tokenizer for the model under test. Also implement a fixture test with a handful of punctuation edge cases.

Zara: CI change: add a gating metric that runs a small sanity set (10 examples) under new runtime and asserts ROUGE delta < 0.5% before allowing merge. I'll add the job to the canary pipeline.

ci-bot: created issue #791: "runtime: revert tokenizer normalization or add eval detok parity". Assigned: Liam (revert PR), Maya (eval adapter), Zara (CI gate).

Ava: timeline? We should aim for revert PR and patch release within 4 hours if possible. Customer impact is limited but visible in dashboards.

Liam: I have the revert branch started, pushing in 20m. Will include changelog and test.

Maya: starting eval adapter now, will try to get a draft in a few hours.

Zara: adding the small sanity job now. Will throttle to not slow merges.

Devon: FYI add note to release notes about normalization behavior so model teams know expected detok semantics.

Ava: thanks all. Keep updates here. If revert goes in, we'll rerun full eval-suite and monitor the dashboard for any residual deltas.

Liam: revert PR opened: https://git.internal/runtime/pull/1234 — awaiting reviewers. CI green for unit tests, e2e eval runs queued.

Maya: eval adapter PR drafted: https://git.internal/eval/pull/567 — contains fixture + README on how to pair runtime tokenizer with eval refs.

Zara: canary gate added to pipeline with job id 9102.

ci-bot: job #4829 (e2e with revert) completed: regression resolved, ROUGE-L delta 0.1%

Ava: closing loop — revert looks good, reharness work tracked and scheduled. Postmortem / short blurb to product for customers? I'll draft one. :thumbsup:

Devon: thanks team. We'll follow up on long-term fix (eval detok parity) next week.
